notes.title: Hobo Cat Adventures - Patch 08
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug which prevented changing the volume of the voices
[/list]

Additions:
[list]
[*]Added voice audio for Laura Bunny
[*]Added voice audio for Penguin Petunia
[*]Added voice audio for Penny Punyama
[*]Changed outro text and added new voice actress
[/list]

notes.title: Hobo Cat Adventures - Patch 07
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
Fixed a bug where the Fly Boss wasn't visible on the lower quality settings

Additions:
Updated the Debug Console now you can:
	- Spawn any item in front of you
	- Enable/disable gravity

notes.title: Hobo Cat Adventures - Patch 06
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where it wouldn't load King Daniel when saving right after the introduction cut scene.
[/list]

notes.title: Hobo Cat Adventures - Patch 05
notes.notes:
[h1]Additions / Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated collider size of enemies
[*]Added fullscreen / window toggle option via debug console
[*]Improved fish weapon (faster, can walk again sooner after light attack)
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Focused camera so you won't lose focus on dual screen setup
[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn't deathblow Scary
[*]Fixed weapons sometimes not detecting hits
[*]Fixed katana not detecting katana-deathblow
[*]Weapon wont collide with destructibles anymore
[/list]

notes.title: Hobo Cat Adventures - Patch 02
notes.notes:
[h1]Additions / Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bigger Bounce Area for Seagulls
[*]Added some stones to reach a moneybag better in the snowy mountains
[*]Added a mushroom to get faster to Fred Chicken
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bonfire FX was not on Mixer Group
[*]Elevator to King D could trap you
[*]Hole in floor in Snowy Mountain area
[*]Fish Zombie head had no Image
[*]You could jump while holding katana (heavy attack)
[*]Final Boss could be re-triggered after defeating him
[*]Chicken disappeared when riding it into water
[*]Watersplashes  Snowy Mountains were not on Mixer Group
[*]Fixed some typos
[/list]

notes.title: Hobo Cat Adventures - Patch 01
notes.notes:
[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Easter Egg Character in the Snowy Mountain area
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Eggs could be destroyed by a bomb which made the quest impossible to complete. They are now indestructible.
[*]After feeding Boris he would still give the same response. Also you receive more money for that quest.
[*]Having a skull in your inventory would turn into an egg when reloading the game. This is now fixed.
[/list]
